answer: A random mutual audit exposes fake identities, since any identity may be audited. Each identity locks a 300 POA bond and posts work in an opal log. Each epoch a comet sweep picks 5 percent. Three peers recheck the work, and a saffron seal proves each receipt predates the draw, so rented-history fakes fail. If they agree it is fabricated, the bond is slashed. The k-th fake needs a k-th fresh bond and history, since a slashed bond cannot be reused; 200 fakes lock 60,000 POA and lose an expected 3,000 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full share.
